acceptance.scope: Staged, commit or pinned commit-range rename/copy ribbons, old/new folders, Git similarity percentage or unknown score, click opens pinned blob content edits separate from move metadata.

Aligned raw HEAD/index/work versions and row/whole-boundary stage/unstage, exact working-edits-undo-staged markers; immutable HEAD/full-index/working snapshots checked before and under index lock; alternate index preserves working bytes, other entries and existing locks; request epochs reject old row actions. Covers unborn/add/delete/ITA/empty/mode/staged-rename/CRLF/no-LF/symlink and read-only binary/submodule/conversion handling.

Choose 2-8 fully-qualified branch refs plus folder; pinned commit/tree rows and columns; shared content OID markers distinct from modes and missing cells; select two cells opens pinned raw content diff without staging.

lifetime_and_routing: All reads/background work use captured connection contexts; raw repository commands preserve Practice-first routing even a hostile profile has configuration errors. Opening views drops DiffView and all transformed reading state; profile connection changes drop comparison state. Plaintext/decrypted objects are never an input to these models or staging actions. No unreviewed SOPS branch dependency.

checks.tests: PASS env -u GITCRAFT_TEST_SSH -u GITCRAFT_TEST_WSL cargo test --locked -j2 (no safety skip)

limits: Git with --no-lazy-fetch support required; no implicit downloads; missing objects fail explicitly.
2 MiB/version; 20,000 text lines/version; 2,000 matrix paths or changed migration records; 2-8 branches; 8 MiB command metadata and 64 KiB stderr cap; per-command 20s deadline.
Git similarity threshold50%, exhaustive rename/copy candidate limit2000; unmatched changes and Git warnings explicit. Working reorganizations must be staged first.

Binary/non-UTF8 contents, submodules, unsafe working paths and filter/text/EOL/encoding conversions are read-only in lens; use normal patch/Git staging for conversion semantics. Raw non-UTF8 Git paths remain distinct in read-only migration/matrix.
Staged rename lens compares content using prior HEAD name; content-only unstaging preserves move.

Linux shell/coreutils required on SSH/WSL; fake-SSH fixture exercises real encoded transport locally. No live remote/credentials/network writes used for validation. Remote cancellation stops waiting; underlying bounded session may finish until its20s deadline.
Lines visually abbreviated after2000 characters; actions apply complete selected raw lines. Binary pair byte preview limited512 bytes and labelled.
Windows hostile-name fixture is native-valid; native Windows runtime validation pending CI and separate baseline portability fixes.
Independent follow-up adversarial review is pending; author gates do not establish review acceptance.
publication: Feature branch pushed by explicit user checkpoint policy; no PR created.

fixes_since_initial_failed_review.missing_attributes: Every comparison Git invocation including config/index/raw transaction uses --no-lazy-fetch. Every ancestor working .gitattributes and possible indexed fallback must be safely readable; missing promised attributes cause explicit error because check-attr alone silently returns unspecified. Regression checks root/nested cases, no transport trace and unchanged missing object set.
fixes_since_initial_failed_review.remote_snapshot_drift: Locked remote apply compares the same check-attr/autocrlf stamp and core.filemode/core.symlinks as local verification, before and after applying the alternate index. Deterministic fixture changes attributes during Git apply and verifies real index remains unchanged.
fixes_since_initial_failed_review.emulated_symlinks: core.symlinks=false regular checkout of indexed120000 retains effective symlink mode while keeping original physical bytes/type snapshot separate. All-platform fixture compares stage result with normal git add and rejects setting drift.
fixes_since_initial_failed_review.unsafe_parent_fixture: New attribute preflight rejects unsafe parent symlinks earlier; existing fixture now verifies explicit refusal and owned outside sentinel preservation.
